title: Unos podataka: konektori, AMA, DCR i tabele
summary: Izbor konektora i unos podataka u Sentinel: Windows Security Events via AMA i DCR (event setovi, XPath), WEF i tabela WindowsEvent, Syslog i CEF via AMA preko Linux forwardera, Azure Activity preko Azure Policy i diagnostic settings, threat indicators (TAXII, upload API, MDTI), custom _CL tabele i DCR transformacije u KQL-u.
title_en: Data ingestion: connectors, AMA, DCR and tables
summary_en: Choosing connectors and ingesting data into Sentinel: Windows Security Events via AMA and DCR (event sets, XPath), WEF and the WindowsEvent table, Syslog and CEF via AMA through a Linux forwarder, Azure Activity via Azure Policy and diagnostic settings, threat indicators (TAXII, upload API, MDTI), custom _CL tables and DCR transformations in KQL.
